papers.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)** to obtain diverse environment sets. For difficulty structure, we propose **Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)**, which organizes curriculum learning through two difficulty levels: harness weakening and state-scale progression. Experiments show that AES and HDC effectively improve multimodal agent training.
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China

ru.title: Качество окружений важнее их количества: разнообразие и структурированная сложность для обучения агентов
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема обучения агентов в многомодальных окружениях, показано что просто увеличение количества сред не всегда улучшает результаты. Авторы предлагают два подхода для построения более эффективного распределения обучающих сред: метод отбора окружений с учетом способностей агента (AES) для повышения разнообразия и иерархический curriculum learning (HDC) для правильной организации сложности обучения на двух уровнях. Экспериментальные результаты демонстрируют что оба предложенных метода значительно улучшают эффективность обучения многомодальных агентов.

en.title: Enhancing Agent Training with Smart Environment Selection and Difficulty Structuring
en.desc: This paper investigates the effectiveness of training agents in multimodal environments. It reveals that merely increasing the number of environments does not guarantee better training outcomes. The authors propose two key strategies: Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES) to enhance diversity in training environments, and Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC) to structure the difficulty of tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that these methods significantly improve the training of multimodal agents.

zh.title: 提升多模态智能体训练的有效性
zh.desc: 最近的研究通过构建大规模的多模态环境池来训练智能体。然而，我们发现仅仅增加多模态环境的数量并不总是有益的。通过一系列实验，我们分析了当前多模态环境分布的局限性。基于这些发现，我们研究了如何从多样性和难度结构两个维度构建更有效的训练环境分布。

papers.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a theoretical explanation for this mechanism by analyzing multi-task gradient interference. Our results reveal a distinction: interference in SFT is norm-limited, scaling with the absolute gradient magnitude, whereas interference in RL is variance-limited, bounded by the gradient variance induced by advantage normalization and on-policy optimization. This small variance bound yields near-orthogonal optimization directions across tasks. Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility.
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China
The Key Laboratory of Cognition and Decision Intelligence for Complex Systems, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China

ru.title: Ортогональные градиенты как ключ к стабильному многозадачному обучению
ru.desc: В статье исследуется, почему обучение с подкреплением (RL) лучше справляется с многозадачным обучением больших языковых моделей, чем традиционное supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Авторы обнаружили, что RL создает разреженные и ортогональные обновления параметров для разных задач, что позволяет избежать конфликтов между ними. Они провели теоретический анализ на уровне градиентов и показали, что помехи в SFT зависят от абсолютной величины градиентов, а в RL - от их дисперсии, которая ограничена нормализацией преимуществ. На основе этого понимания авторы предложили метод Parallel-RL для эффективного разделения многозадачного обучения.

en.title: Unlocking Multi-Task Mastery with Parallel-RL
en.desc: This paper explores how Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) affect the performance of large language models (LLMs) in multi-task reasoning. It finds that SFT struggles with task conflicts during training, while RL allows for stable performance across various tasks. The authors identify that RL leads to sparse updates that are nearly orthogonal, reducing interference between tasks. They introduce a new approach called Parallel-RL, which separates multi-task training to enhance efficiency and adaptability in model training.

zh.title: 解耦多任务训练，提升效率与灵活性
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）在增强大型语言模型（LLMs）多任务推理中的不同表现。研究发现，SFT在多阶段训练中会遭遇严重的任务冲突，而RL则能够在不同任务之间实现稳定共存。通过对多任务梯度干扰的分析，论文提供了理论解释，指出SFT的干扰是由梯度的绝对大小限制的，而RL的干扰则是由梯度方差限制的。基于这一发现，作者提出了Parallel-RL方法，旨在解耦多任务训练，从而显著提高效率和灵活性。

papers.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Abstract  World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods require costly future generation at inference. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing the video branch to be discarded after training and leaving a self-contained planner that directly predicts trajectories. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves 91.5 PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/

ru.title: От видео к действиям: лёгкий планировщик траекторий для автономного вождения
ru.desc: В статье предлагается SimWAM — эффективная модель мира для автономного вождения, которая использует генерацию видео только как сигнал обучения, а не для вывода. Метод совместно тренирует предварительно обученного видео-эксперта и лёгкого эксперта действий с помощью flow matching, при этом маска внимания изолирует предсказание действий от будущих кадров. После обучения ветка видео отбрасывается, оставляя независимый планировщик, который напрямую предсказывает траектории, что снижает задержку вывода. Авторы дополнительно применяют reinforcement learning для оптимизации композиционной функции награды вождения, достигая лучших результатов на бенчмарке NAVSIM и демонстрируя zero-shot трансфер на nuScenes.

en.title: SimWAM: Efficient Action Prediction for Autonomous Driving
en.desc: The paper introduces SimWAM, a novel World-Action Model that enhances autonomous driving by utilizing video generation solely as a training tool rather than during inference. It features a co-training approach between a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert, utilizing joint flow matching to improve action prediction. An isolated attention mask allows the action expert to function independently of future video frames, enabling the video component to be removed after training. SimWAM demonstrates superior performance with lower latency compared to existing models, making it a promising baseline for future advancements in video generation for autonomous driving.

zh.title: SimWAM：高效的自动驾驶新基准
zh.desc: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过将视频动态先验转移到动作预测中，提升了端到端的自动驾驶能力，但现有方法在推理时需要昂贵的未来生成。我们提出了SimWAM，这是一种简单而有效的WAM，仅将视频生成作为训练信号。它通过联合流匹配共同训练一个预训练的视频专家和一个轻量级的动作专家。SimWAM在NAVSIM上实现了91.5的PDMS，超越了最先进的WAM规划器，并且具有显著更低的延迟。

papers.title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract  Deploying autonomous multimodal agents in continuous, real-world environments requires them to ingest unbounded audio-visual streams and maintain hour-scale memory. However, current evaluations predominantly rely on brief clips and multiple-choice formats. This design allows minimal baselines that process only the last four frames to match or surpass complex streaming models, while answer options also expose language shortcuts. We introduce StreamArena, a benchmark for hour-scale, interactive streaming video understanding. StreamArena contains 243 full-length videos averaging 88.8 minutes and 3,646 rigorously annotated, open-ended question-answer pairs that evaluate real-time perception, historical retrospection, proactive interaction, and multimodal tool utilization. Evaluation across diverse systems exposes a tension between continuous interaction and long-horizon multimodal comprehension. Methods that retain only recent frames cannot recover distant events, methods that convert past observations into text lose visual evidence, and methods that repeatedly compress visual memory struggle to preserve fine-grained details over time. We address this tension with StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that assigns latency-critical interaction and proactive monitoring to independently scheduled frontend workers, while backend workers asynchronously construct persistent multimodal memory and perform historical recall and external search. StreamMind outperforms existing streaming baselines across all four capabilities and reduces query-to-answer latency by reusing persistent state.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Долгосрочная мультимодальная память для потокового видеопонимания
ru.desc: В статье предлагается новый бенчмарк StreamArena для оценки мультимодальных агентов на длинных видеопотоках длительностью час и более, содержащий 243 полнометражных видео с открытыми вопросами для проверки восприятия в реальном времени и долгосрочной памяти. Авторы выявили фундаментальное противоречие в существующих подходах: простые модели, обрабатывающие только последние кадры, теряют исторический контекст, текстовые представления прошлых наблюдений теряют визуальную информацию, а методы сжатия памяти не сохраняют мелкие детали. Для решения этой проблемы предложена архитектура StreamMind с двухуровневой организацией: фронтенд-воркеры обрабатывают критичные по времени запросы и мониторинг, а бэкенд-воркеры асинхронно строят персистентную мультимодальную память и выполняют исторический поиск. StreamMind превосходит базовые модели по всем четырем способностям и снижает задержку ответа за счёт переиспользования сохранённого состояния.

en.title: StreamMind: Enhancing Multimodal Memory for Real-Time Interaction
en.desc: This paper discusses the challenges of deploying autonomous multimodal agents that can process continuous audio-visual streams and maintain long-term memory. Current evaluation methods are inadequate as they rely on short clips, allowing simpler models to perform well against complex systems. The authors introduce StreamArena, a new benchmark featuring long videos and open-ended questions to better assess real-time and historical understanding. They propose StreamMind, a two-tier architecture that effectively manages interaction and memory, outperforming existing models in various tasks while reducing response times.

zh.title: StreamArena：长时间视频理解的新基准
zh.desc: 本论文提出了StreamArena，这是一个用于评估自主多模态智能体在真实环境中处理长时间视频流的基准。该基准包含243个完整视频和3646个经过严格注释的开放式问答对，旨在测试实时感知、历史回顾、主动交互和多模态工具使用能力。我们还介绍了StreamMind，这是一种两层架构，能够有效管理交互延迟和持久多模态记忆的构建。StreamMind在所有四个能力上超越了现有的流媒体基线，并通过重用持久状态减少了查询到回答的延迟。

papers.title: YOLO-PEFT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on YOLO Family
papers.abstract: Abstract  Generic parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods transferred from language models can fail silently on real-time detectors, whose heterogeneous operators and detection-specific components impose placement constraints absent from regular Transformer stacks. We propose YOLO-PEFT, a structure-aware framework that formulates adapter placement as an auditable constraint-planning problem. Given a detector graph, a PEFT request, and a resource budget, YOLO-PEFT assigns operator and semantic roles, evaluates explicit operator-validity, detector-semantic, graph-interface, and deployment predicates, records a reason code for each excluded module, and either emits a budgeted target-module plan or returns Refuse before training. Under the official VOC07+12 trainval-to-VOC07 test protocol, planner-selected RS-LoRA reaches 0.7138 and 0.7307 mAP50-95 on YOLO11s and YOLO12s, respectively, compared with 0.6428 and 0.6662 for Full-SFT. On RT-DETR-L, all seven evaluated LoRA-family configurations cross the predefined catastrophic threshold, supporting a calibrated Refuse-to-Full-SFT decision within the evaluated coverage. A controlled YOLO11 audit further shows that LoRA reduces peak training memory by 43.9 percent, although training takes 1.72 times longer. Within the evaluated detector families, placement policies, and calibration coverage, YOLO-PEFT replaces manual target-module trial and error with explicit, inspectable planning while preserving verified train-save-merge-export paths; refusal on unseen detector architectures remains an open validation problem. Project Page: github.com/Tencent/YOLO-Master

ru.title: Умное планирование адаптеров для детекторов объектов вместо слепого подбора
ru.desc: В статье предлагается YOLO-PEFT — новый подход для эффективной адаптации моделей детектирования объектов, который решает проблему применения методов PEFT, разработанных для языковых моделей, к специализированным архитектурам детекторов. Авторы формулируют задачу размещения адаптеров как проблему планирования с явными ограничениями, проверяя валидность операторов и семантическую согласованность с графом детектора. Фреймворк обеспечивает значительное снижение памяти во время обучения (на 43,9%) при сохранении высокого качества детектирования, превосходя полное дообучение на эталонных наборах данных VOC. Метод заменяет ручной подбор целевых модулей на прозрачное и проверяемое планирование, предоставляя детальный отчёт о причинах исключения модулей.

en.title: Optimizing Fine-Tuning with YOLO-PEFT for Real-Time Detection
en.desc: The paper introduces YOLO-PEFT, a new framework designed to improve the fine-tuning of machine learning models for real-time detection tasks. It addresses the challenges of placing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods within the constraints of heterogeneous detector architectures. YOLO-PEFT formulates the placement of adapters as a constraint-planning problem, ensuring that the selected modules are valid and meet the specific requirements of the detection task. The results show that YOLO-PEFT significantly enhances performance while reducing memory usage during training, although it may increase training time.

zh.title: YOLO-PEFT：高效的检测器微调新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为YOLO-PEFT的框架，旨在解决在实时检测器中进行参数高效微调时的挑战。该框架将适配器放置视为一个可审计的约束规划问题，能够根据检测器图、PEFT请求和资源预算进行优化。YOLO-PEFT通过评估操作符有效性和语义角色，生成预算目标模块计划，或在训练前拒绝不合适的模块。实验结果表明，YOLO-PEFT在多个检测器上显著提高了性能，同时减少了训练内存的峰值需求。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Audio reasoning is essential for machine understanding of the acoustic world. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can elicit such reasoning, yet existing reward designs are complementary in their limitations: outcome-based rewards supervise only the final answer and let the model reach it without attending to the audio, whereas process-based rewards score the reasoning itself but rely on coarse, hand-crafted, and fixed criteria that neither adapt to each question nor stay grounded in the acoustic evidence. Moreover, questions differ in what they demand, with some hinging on perception and others on multi-step reasoning, and any static criterion weakens as the policy improves. Supervising the reasoning process with fine-grained, audio-grounded, and adaptive rewards is therefore crucial, yet challenging since such rewards are impractical to design by hand for every sample. To this end, we introduce AudioRubrics, a reinforcement learning framework that supervises audio reasoning with self-evolving, audio-grounded rubric rewards. AudioRubrics synthesizes per-sample rubrics from the raw waveform and, conditioned on the model's own rollouts, regenerates and reweights criteria per group, supplying a continuous learning signal that keeps targeting the current policy's weaknesses as static criteria saturate. Comprehensive evaluations across three audio reasoning benchmarks reveal that AudioRubrics substantially outperforms a wide range of open-source and training-based baselines. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the gains scale with the capability of the rubric generator and judge, and AudioRubrics converges to a stable reasoning length that avoids both degenerate collapse and unbounded growth. The improvement in audio perception further demonstrates the effectiveness of anchoring supervision in the acoustic evidence. Our project page is available at https://audiorubrics.github.io.

ru.title: Адаптивные критерии оценки для обучения моделей рассуждению на основе звука
ru.desc: В работе предлагается AudioRubrics — фреймворк обучения с подкреплением, который использует адаптивные критерии оценки (rubrics) для развития навыков рассуждения на основе звука. В отличие от традиционных подходов, которые либо оценивают только финальный ответ, либо используют статичные предопределённые критерии, данный метод синтезирует индивидуальные для каждого образца критерии, непосредственно опираясь на звуковую информацию. Критерии автоматически обновляются и переутяживаются по группам на основе выполненных моделью попыток, обеспечивая постоянный сигнал обратной связи, который адаптируется к текущим слабостям модели. Экспериментальные результаты на трёх бенчмарках показывают значительное улучшение качества обучения звукового рассуждения и демонстрируют эффективность привязки обучения к акустическим признакам.

en.title: Evolving Rewards for Enhanced Audio Reasoning
en.desc: This paper presents AudioRubrics, a novel reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance audio reasoning in machines. It addresses the limitations of existing reward systems by providing fine-grained, audio-grounded, and adaptive rewards that evolve based on the model's performance. By synthesizing per-sample rubrics from audio data, AudioRubrics offers a continuous learning signal that adapts to the model's weaknesses, improving its reasoning capabilities. The framework has been shown to significantly outperform existing methods across various audio reasoning tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in grounding supervision in acoustic evidence.

zh.title: 音频推理的新突破：AudioRubrics
zh.desc: 音频推理对于机器理解声学世界至关重要。现有的强化学习奖励设计存在局限，结果导向的奖励只关注最终答案，而过程导向的奖励则依赖于粗糙的手工标准。我们提出了AudioRubrics，一个强化学习框架，通过自我演变的音频基础评分标准来监督音频推理。实验结果表明，AudioRubrics在多个音频推理基准上显著优于现有方法，且能够有效提升音频感知能力。

papers.title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
papers.abstract: Abstract  Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.

ru.title: Скрытые предубеждения оракулов активаций: когда читатели информации становятся её скрывателями
ru.desc: В статье исследуются Activation Oracles (AOs) — языковые модели, которые обучены отвечать на вопросы о внутренних активациях других моделей. Авторы показывают, что хотя AOs могут считываться как нейтральные датчики скрытой информации, на самом деле они являются обучаемыми системами с собственным поведением и предубеждениями. В контролируемом эксперименте с задачей угадывания запретного слова исследователи обнаружили парадоксальный результат: обученные AOs могут избирательно не восстанавливать концепции, которые были активны во время их обучения. Результаты показывают, что поведенческие утечки информации, декодируемость на уровне представлений и возможность вербализации AO могут не совпадать, что ставит вопросы о надежности интерпретируемости через обученные интерфейсы.

en.title: Activation Oracles: The Challenge of Reliable Model Interpretation
en.desc: This paper introduces Activation Oracles (AOs), which are language models designed to interpret and answer questions about the internal workings of other models. AOs can access hidden information that may not be directly observable in a model's behavior. However, the study reveals that AOs can become biased and fail to accurately report the concepts they were trained on, acting instead as 'anti-readers'. This highlights a significant issue in the reliability of interpretability tools, as the ability to decode information does not guarantee accurate verbalization of that information.

zh.title: 激活预言机的可靠性挑战
zh.desc: 激活预言机（AOs）是一种语言模型，旨在回答关于其他模型内部激活的自然语言问题。它们提供了一种灵活的接口，可以从模型状态中读取隐藏信息，尤其是在相关信息内部表示但在可见行为中缺失或不完整时。然而，AOs本身也是学习系统：它们的回答受到训练数据、目标和学习的报告行为的影响，而不是中立的信息读取。我们的研究表明，经过微调的AOs可能会成为概念特定的反阅读者，选择性地无法恢复在其训练过程中持续存在的概念，这引发了对学习可解释性接口可靠性的担忧。

papers.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for LLMs: Offline Top-K Logits and a Fused Chunked KL Loss
papers.abstract: Abstract  Small language models are often the only option for deployment under tight latency, cost, and on-premises constraints, but they are rarely trained from scratch: a compressed model is usually recovered through knowledge distillation (KD). This recovery step largely decides the final quality, yet it is expensive. We present a practitioner's study of how to make distillation training efficient, organised around two systems contributions. First, we show that offline KD (caching the teacher's top-K logits once and training the student against the cache) matches online distillation at near-identical training loss while removing the teacher from memory, running about 29\% faster per iteration, and reaching up to 41\% higher throughput on a single H200 GPU. Second, we introduce a fused, chunked KL loss that never materialises the full vocabulary-sized logit tensor, making peak memory linear in the sequence length. This removes the memory spike that otherwise caps context length and lets us train at four times the context (32{,}768 tokens) on a single GPU. A separate output-head-only toy benchmark isolates the loss kernel and confirms its memory and iteration-rate scaling from 4K to 256K tokens. Together these make large-scale healing and hundreds of ablations affordable. We also report supporting ablations on loss design and sequence packing. We release our chunked-loss implementation: https://github.com/CompactifAI/Full-Chunked-KL-Loss.

ru.title: Дешёвая дистилляция: как обучать малые модели экономно и быстро
ru.desc: В работе представлены методы оптимизации обучения малых языковых моделей через дистилляцию знаний. Авторы показывают, что офлайновая дистилляция, где логиты учителя кэшируются один раз, достигает качества онлайн-дистилляции при меньшем расходе памяти и на 29% быстрее. Они также предлагают оптимизированный алгоритм вычисления KL-потерь, который избегает материализации полного тензора словаря и снижает пиковое потребление памяти до линейной зависимости от длины последовательности. Такие оптимизации позволяют обучать модели с контекстом из 32,768 токенов на одном GPU и делают крупномасштабное обучение доступным на ограниченных ресурсах.

en.title: Efficient Knowledge Distillation for Small Language Models
en.desc: This paper focuses on improving the efficiency of knowledge distillation (KD) for training small language models, which are crucial for deployment in resource-constrained environments. The authors propose two main contributions: first, they demonstrate that offline KD can achieve similar training loss to online distillation while being significantly faster and more memory-efficient. Second, they introduce a novel fused, chunked KL loss that reduces memory usage by avoiding the creation of large logit tensors, allowing for longer context lengths during training. These advancements make it feasible to conduct large-scale experiments and optimizations in model training.

zh.title: 提升小型语言模型训练效率的创新方法
zh.desc: 小型语言模型在延迟、成本和本地部署的限制下，通常是唯一的选择，但它们很少从头开始训练。知识蒸馏（KD）是恢复压缩模型的常用方法，但这一过程成本高昂。本文提出了提高蒸馏训练效率的两种方法：首先，离线KD通过缓存教师模型的输出，显著提高训练速度；其次，采用分块的KL损失，避免了全词汇大小的内存消耗，使得在单个GPU上可以处理更长的上下文。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware World Model for Aerial Image-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Aerial image-goal navigation requires an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to reach a target location specified by a goal image. Existing world-model-based methods rank candidate trajectories using predicted futures, but typically rely on only one or a few point predictions, which is inadequate for large-scale outdoor environments with substantial future-state uncertainty. To address this limitation, we propose the Uncertainty-Aware Navigation World Model (UA-NWM), an efficient latent world model for aerial image-goal navigation, which formulates trajectory scoring as conditional out-of-distribution detection. UA-NWM represents plausible futures with an uncertainty subspace and decomposes the prediction--goal discrepancy into uncertainty-explainable and unexplainable components. Only the unexplainable residual is used for scoring, enabling robust selection without multiple future samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UA-NWM consistently outperforms existing navigation world models while maintaining low inference latency. Real-world UAV experiments further validate its practical applicability. Project page: https://duryi.github.io/UA-NWM-Project-Page
affiliations: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

ru.title: Навигация дрона через моделирование неопределённости будущих состояний
ru.desc: В работе предложена модель мира UA-NWM для навигации беспилотника к целевой точке по изображению. Метод использует латентное представление для эффективного предсказания будущих траекторий и формирует задачу выбора пути как обнаружение выбросов из распределения. Ключевая особенность — разложение расхождения между предсказанием и целью на объяснимую неопределённостью и необъяснимую части, что позволяет робастно выбирать траектории без множественных сэмплирований. Метод демонстрирует превосходство над существующими подходами при низкой задержке вывода и подтверждается экспериментами на реальных беспилотниках.

en.title: Navigating Uncertainty: UA-NWM for Aerial Image Goals
en.desc: This paper introduces the Uncertainty-Aware Navigation World Model (UA-NWM) for aerial image-goal navigation, which helps unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) reach target locations based on images. Unlike traditional methods that rely on limited future predictions, UA-NWM effectively handles uncertainty in large outdoor environments by using a latent world model. It scores trajectories by identifying and separating explainable and unexplainable discrepancies between predictions and goals, focusing only on the unexplainable part for robust decision-making. The results show that UA-NWM outperforms existing models while ensuring quick inference times, making it suitable for real-world UAV applications.

zh.title: 不确定性感知，精准导航！
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种新的无人机导航模型，称为不确定性感知导航世界模型（UA-NWM），用于根据目标图像导航到指定位置。现有的方法通常依赖于少量的未来状态预测，这在复杂的户外环境中效果不佳。UA-NWM通过将轨迹评分视为条件性分布外检测，来处理未来状态的不确定性。实验结果表明，UA-NWM在导航性能上优于现有模型，并且具有较低的推理延迟，适用于实际无人机操作。

papers.title: Douyin Multimodal Embedding Model Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multimodal representation learning is a cornerstone of modern AI. By encoding multimodal queries and targets into vectors, it powers industrial search and recommendation and underpins modern agents. Real-world platforms with complex modalities and massive-scale content, such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and YouTube, demand both efficiency under billion-scale indexing and fine-grained discrimination for hard matching. Existing MLLM embedding models rarely satisfy both. Contrastive models are efficient but rely on pair-level supervision too coarse for fine-grained distinctions, while CoT-based models improve discrimination through explicit generation impractical to serve online. We present Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a model trained in two stages to combine both strengths. Stage 1 performs large-scale contrastive pre-training that establishes a unified multimodal embedding space with broad modality and task coverage. Stage 2 supplements semantic sufficiency, the property that an embedding is grounded in retrieval-relevant evidence and preserves fine-grained counterpart-side semantics, via two mechanisms. Evidence-Grounded Typed Latent Reasoning organizes retrieval evidence through hidden-space latent reasoning, and Cross-Conditional Reconstruction enforces counterpart-side semantics through cross-directional autoregressive reconstruction. Both act only during training and add only marginal query-side overhead, so DME serves as efficiently as a standard contrastive encoder. On MMEB-v2, DME reaches state-of-the-art results at comparable scales for its 2B and 9B variants (74.8 and 78.4), with especially strong video and visual-document tasks. In production, DME delivers a 2.92% relative gain on Douyin's in-house offline evaluation set, is deployed across Douyin scenarios such as generative, image, and AI search, and yields a 0.1% Lifetime (LT) gain in online A/B testing on Douyin search.

ru.title: Эффективные и точные мультимодальные представления для масштабного поиска
ru.desc: В статье представляется модель DME для мультимодального обучения представлений, которая объединяет эффективность контрастивного обучения с тонкой дискриминацией через механизмы скрытого рассуждения и кросс-условной реконструкции. Модель обучается в два этапа: сначала проводится крупномасштабное контрастивное предварительное обучение для создания единого мультимодального пространства встраиваний, затем добавляются механизмы для улучшения семантической достаточности без увеличения вычислительных затрат при инференсе. DME достигает лучших результатов на бенчмарке MMEB-v2 и успешно развёрнута в производстве на платформе Douyin для задач поиска и рекомендаций с миллиардами элементов контента. Модель показывает практическое улучшение качества на реальных данных и демонстрирует, как эффективность и точность могут быть одновременно достигнуты в мультимодальных системах поиска.

en.title: Efficient Multimodal Learning with Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME)
en.desc: This paper introduces Douyin Multimodal Embedding (DME), a novel model designed for efficient multimodal representation learning. DME combines the strengths of contrastive models and CoT-based models by using a two-stage training process. The first stage focuses on large-scale contrastive pre-training to create a unified embedding space, while the second stage enhances semantic sufficiency through advanced reasoning and reconstruction techniques. As a result, DME achieves state-of-the-art performance on multimodal tasks while maintaining efficiency suitable for real-world applications.

zh.title: 抖音多模态嵌入：高效与精确的结合
zh.desc: 多模态表示学习是现代人工智能的基础。本文提出了抖音多模态嵌入（DME）模型，通过两阶段训练结合了高效性和细粒度区分能力。第一阶段进行大规模对比预训练，建立统一的多模态嵌入空间；第二阶段通过证据驱动的潜在推理和交叉条件重构增强语义充分性。DME在MMEB-v2上达到了最先进的结果，并在抖音的实际应用中显著提升了搜索性能。

papers.title: Skaling: Chinchilla's Exponents Meet Kaplan's Coupling
papers.abstract: Abstract  Neural scaling laws are foundational for language model development, yet standard formulations systematically under- and overestimate loss at data-scarce and overtraining extremes. This failure originates in the underlying assumption that model size and training data impact the loss independently. To address this, we introduce the Skaling law, a generalized functional form that couples model capacity and data through a single interaction exponent. This simple extension reduces the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) by 1.5-3x across both interpolation and extrapolation regimes. When paired with a sparse grid strategy restricted to low-compute regimes, the Skaling law achieves accurate full-grid extrapolation using approximately 10x less compute than uniform sweeps. By enabling reliable performance prediction from small-scale experiments, the Skaling law provides a more robust and resource-efficient framework for allocating compute budgets in next-generation model training.

ru.title: Связанный закон масштабирования: от малых экспериментов к точным предсказаниям больших моделей
ru.desc: В статье предложена новая формулировка закона масштабирования нейронных сетей, которая решает проблему неточных предсказаний потерь при нехватке данных и переобучении. Авторы вводят Skaling law — обобщённую функциональную форму, которая связывает размер модели и объём обучающих данных через единый показатель взаимодействия. Новый подход снижает среднюю процентную ошибку в 1,5-3 раза как при интерполяции, так и при экстраполяции результатов. Метод позволяет точно предсказывать производительность моделей на основе малых экспериментов, сокращая требуемые вычислительные ресурсы примерно в 10 раз.

en.title: Skaling Law: Optimizing Model Training with Less Compute
en.desc: This paper introduces the Skaling law, a new approach to understanding how model size and training data interact to affect loss in language models. Traditional methods often misestimate loss, especially when data is limited or when models are overtrained, because they treat model capacity and data as independent factors. The Skaling law combines these two elements into a single framework, significantly improving prediction accuracy and reducing errors in performance estimates. By using this method, researchers can optimize their compute resources more effectively, achieving better results with less computational effort.

zh.title: Skaling法则：提升模型训练效率的新方法
zh.desc: 神经网络的扩展法则是语言模型发展的基础，但标准公式在数据稀缺和过度训练的极端情况下系统性地低估和高估损失。这种失败源于对模型大小和训练数据影响损失的独立假设。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Skaling法则，这是一种将模型容量和数据通过单一交互指数耦合的广义函数形式。这个简单的扩展在插值和外推的情况下将平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）降低了1.5到3倍。

papers.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  We study visual persistence in interactive video world models. These models rely on a Key-Value (KV) cache as a growing visual memory to carry forward previously generated frames. However, we find that models can no longer reliably address stored content once rollouts extend beyond the training horizon, because temporal Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) offsets then fall outside the range seen during training and the model struggles to retrieve the relevant visual information through attention. Moreover, naively compressing the cache in the RoPE-rotated space corrupts memory by averaging together incompatible positional phases. To address this, we propose WorldTrace, a training-free memory framework for long-horizon visual persistence. WorldTrace keeps compressed memory addressable by assigning each summary slot a distinct, in-distribution virtual position. Within this addressable cache, we study two memory compression approaches: WorldTrace-Field compresses history for temporal coherence, while WorldTrace-Landmark stores verbatim scene traces at detected transitions for episodic recall. We further introduce LoopBench, a benchmark evaluating whether a compressed cache can reconstruct a previously visited scene after a long detour. WorldTrace-Field improves temporal consistency by +15.5%, and WorldTrace-Landmark improves episodic recall by +19.5% on LoopBench, extending visually persistent generation without retraining.

ru.title: Адресуемая память для долгосрочной визуальной согласованности в видео-моделях мира
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема визуальной памяти в интерактивных видео-моделях мира, которые используют кэш Key-Value для хранения ранее сгенерированных кадров. Авторы обнаружили, что модели теряют способность получать доступ к сохранённой информации при выходе за пределы горизонта обучения из-за смещений позиционных кодировок RoPE, выходящих за пределы диапазона обучения. Предложен метод WorldTrace — фреймворк сжатия памяти без переобучения, который сохраняет адресуемость кэша, присваивая каждому элементу виртуальную позицию из распределения обучения. Метод достигает улучшения временной консистентности на 15.5% и точности воспроизведения сцен на 19.5%, позволяя генерировать визуально непротиворечивые видео на долгих горизонтах.

en.title: Enhancing Visual Memory in Interactive Video Models with WorldTrace
en.desc: This paper investigates how interactive video models can maintain visual memory over time using a Key-Value (KV) cache. The authors identify that existing models struggle to retrieve visual information when the time extends beyond their training limits due to issues with positional embeddings. To solve this, they introduce WorldTrace, a new memory framework that allows for long-term visual persistence without the need for retraining. They also present two methods for memory compression, which significantly enhance the model's ability to recall past scenes accurately and maintain temporal coherence.

zh.title: 提升视觉持久性的创新记忆框架
zh.desc: 本文研究了交互视频世界模型中的视觉持久性。这些模型依赖于键值（KV）缓存作为不断增长的视觉记忆，以保留之前生成的帧。然而，当生成的内容超出训练范围时，模型无法可靠地访问存储的内容，因为时间旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）偏移超出了训练期间的范围，导致模型在通过注意力机制检索相关视觉信息时遇到困难。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了WorldTrace，一个无需训练的内存框架，用于长时间的视觉持久性。

papers.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
papers.abstract: Abstract  Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. When retained text contains an answer but deleted text defines the entity needed to interpret it, we call the result referential dangling. At a compression ratio of 0.30, Beaver, which ranks coherent chunks using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, leaves the answer path incomplete in 34-54% of bridge examples across three multi-hop question answering datasets. On a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six hard compressors we test exhibit dangling at rates up to 60%, and every document in LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA contains at least one dangling reference. On dangling examples evaluated with Qwen3-8B, reinserting the missing supporting paragraph while removing nonsupporting paragraphs to maintain the token budget improves accuracy by 29-34 percentage points (p < 0.0001), recovering at least 88% of the gap to contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Stronger answer models do not absorb the loss: on MuSiQue, GPT-5.5 is 8.8 points less accurate on compressed contexts than on contexts retaining both supporting paragraphs. Finally, we train a compact classifier to rank omitted sentences by whether they are needed to interpret retained text and reinsert the top-ranked candidates without support annotations at inference. On HotpotQA with Qwen3-8B, this automatic restoration improves accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31. Hard compressors should optimize both relevance and referential completeness.
affiliations: Ant Group Security and Intelligence Laboratory (SIL)
School of Computer Technology and Application, Qinghai University

ru.title: Сохрани связь: как восстановить пропущенные ссылки при сжатии контекста
ru.desc: Статья выявляет структурный недостаток в методах жёсткого сжатия контекста, которые независимо оценивают токены и фрагменты текста. Проблема заключается в том, что такой подход может разделить связанные пары информации: оставить ответ на вопрос, но удалить определение сущности, необходимое для его интерпретации — авторы называют это «свисающей ссылкой». На примере задач многоступенчатого ответа на вопросы показано, что все протестированные методы сжатия оставляют неполный путь рассуждений в 34-60% случаев. Предложено решение: обучить компактный классификатор для определения опущенных предложений, необходимых для интерпретации оставленного текста, что повышает точность на 4.7 пункта без значительного ухудшения степени сжатия.

en.title: Optimizing Context: Avoiding Referential Dangling in Prompt Compression
en.desc: This paper discusses a method called hard prompt compression, which aims to reduce the cost of processing long texts by selecting the most relevant parts. However, the authors identify a problem where important related information can be lost, leading to incomplete understanding, which they term 'referential dangling'. They demonstrate that this issue occurs frequently in multi-hop question answering tasks, where the absence of necessary context can significantly lower accuracy. To address this, they propose a solution that involves reintroducing critical omitted sentences, which improves the performance of the model without significantly increasing the amount of text processed.

zh.title: 优化压缩，避免引用悬空
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了硬提示压缩在长上下文推理中的应用，指出了独立选择可能导致依赖证据对的分裂问题。研究发现，当保留的文本包含答案而删除的文本定义了解释答案所需的实体时，会出现所谓的“引用悬空”现象。通过对多个多跳问答数据集的实验，发现现有的硬压缩方法在高达60%的情况下会导致引用悬空，影响推理的准确性。论文提出了一种紧凑的分类器来评估被省略句子的必要性，从而在推理时自动恢复重要的句子，显著提高了准确率。

papers.title: Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors
papers.abstract: Abstract  Autoregressive models accumulate error over long rollouts, yet at deployment there is no ground truth to measure it against. We train a single conditional latent diffusion model that steps a dynamical system forward or backward in time via a direction flag, and show that this bidirectionality supplies a measurement-free test-time error signal: rolling forward i steps and then backward i steps must return the model to its start, so the round-trip discrepancy C_i is a self-supervised proxy for the unobservable rollout error: no ensembles, no held-out data, no governing equations, for one extra rollout. We validate on compressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD), an astrophysical turbulent radiative mixing layer, and natural face videos (CelebV-HQ). On held-out MHD trajectories, C_i ranks rollout error (Spearman 0.91-0.98 at fixed depth; 0.69 pm 0.16 within trajectories), and a simple calibrator fit on training rollouts predicts its magnitude to within 1.14times (68%) and 1.29times (95%) with near-nominal coverage - one nat beyond a depth-only predictor, transferring to all six decoded physical fields. The same signal flags the out-of-distribution Orszag-Tang vortex (AUROC 0.98; 1.0 by depth 10) exactly where sampling-dispersion baselines invert, and it cuts incurred error by 15% at 80% coverage - three times the depth-only baseline. Bidirectional training comes at negative cost, beating direction specialists in both directions, and the backward direction doubles as a fast inverse solver. On LE-PDE-UQ's turbulent Navier-Stokes benchmark, a single bidirectional model reaches accuracy within 1.3times of their ten-model ensemble at a tenth of the training cost, with the best training-free pixel-level calibration. Round-trip consistency turns reversibility into a practical trust signal for generative models.

ru.title: Круговая согласованность как мера доверия для обобщающих моделей
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают обучить единую условную диффузионную модель, которая может развивать динамическую систему вперед и назад по времени с использованием флага направления. Ключевая идея заключается в том, что если откатить прогноз на i шагов вперед, а затем на i шагов назад, модель должна вернуться в исходное состояние, и несоответствие в этом круговом пути служит сигналом ошибки без учителя. Это позволяет измерять накопленную ошибку автогрессивных моделей во время инференса без необходимости в ансамблях или зарезервированных данных. Метод валидирован на физических симуляциях (магнитогидродинамика, турбулентные слои) и видео лиц, демонстрируя высокую корреляцию между предложенной метрикой и реальной ошибкой прогноза.

en.title: Bidirectional Models: Self-Supervised Error Measurement for Better Predictions
en.desc: This paper presents a novel approach using a conditional latent diffusion model that can predict the future and past states of a dynamical system. By leveraging bidirectionality, the model creates a self-supervised error signal that allows it to assess its own performance without needing ground truth data. The authors validate their method on various complex systems, demonstrating that the round-trip discrepancy can effectively indicate rollout errors and improve prediction accuracy. The results show that this approach not only reduces error but also requires significantly less training resources compared to traditional ensemble methods.

zh.title: 双向训练：生成模型的新信任信号
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种条件潜在扩散模型，能够在时间上前后推演动态系统。通过双向性，该模型提供了一种无需测量的测试时误差信号，确保在前进和后退的过程中返回到起始点。研究表明，这种方法在多个领域（如磁流体动力学和自然面部视频）中有效，能够准确预测未观察到的回滚误差。双向训练不仅提高了模型的准确性，还降低了训练成本，展示了生成模型的可逆性作为信任信号的潜力。

papers.title: The Optimizer Is the Agent: Reasoning-Driven Search across Prompts, Programs, and ML Workflows
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent systems for optimizing prompts, programs, and ML workflows typically rely on explicit outer-loop controllers such as evolutionary search, bandits, or textual-gradient methods. We ask a fundamentally different question: how much of this search policy can be internalized by a single tool-using agent? We present ReASearch, a unified framework for reasoning-driven optimization in which the agent autonomously decides what to evaluate, how to diagnose failures, which edits to make, and when to verify or restart. Rather than serving only as a proposal generator guided by hand-designed heuristics, the agent actively analyzes outcomes, allocates budget, and refines its strategy over long horizons through persistent memory. With a shared agent loop and domain-specific tools, ReASearch instantiates the exact same scaffold to optimize prompts, programs, and ML workflows. Across 14 diverse tasks, it is competitive with and mostly better than specialized optimization systems, achieving gains of 2% to 40% over strong domain-specific baselines, and in some cases discovering solutions that improve on prior human best-known results. Crucially, we observe that complex search behaviors, which are typically implemented by explicit controllers, emerge naturally from the agent's reasoning process.
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin

ru.title: Автономный агент вместо явного контроллера: внутренняя оптимизация через рассуждение
ru.desc: В статье представлена система ReASearch, которая использует единого агента с инструментами для оптимизации промптов, программ и ML-рабочих потоков вместо явных внешних контроллеров типа эволюционного поиска или градиентных методов. Агент самостоятельно принимает решения о том, что оценивать, как диагностировать ошибки, какие изменения делать и когда проверять результаты, используя устойчивую память для анализа результатов на длительных горизонтах. Одна и та же архитектура агента с доменоспецифичными инструментами применяется ко всем трём задачам оптимизации. На 14 разнообразных задачах система показывает результаты, конкурентные или превосходящие специализированные системы оптимизации на 2-40%, при этом сложное поисковое поведение возникает естественным образом из процесса рассуждений агента.

en.title: Empowering Agents: Internalizing Optimization for Enhanced Performance
en.desc: The paper introduces ReASearch, a novel framework for optimizing prompts, programs, and machine learning workflows through a single autonomous agent. Unlike traditional methods that use external controllers for optimization, ReASearch allows the agent to internally manage its evaluation processes, diagnose failures, and refine strategies based on outcomes. This approach leverages persistent memory to enhance decision-making over extended periods, enabling the agent to adapt and improve its performance. The results show that ReASearch outperforms many specialized systems across various tasks, demonstrating that complex search behaviors can emerge from the agent's reasoning without the need for explicit external guidance.

zh.title: 智能体驱动的优化新方法
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为ReASearch的统一框架，用于基于推理的优化。该框架允许智能体自主决定评估内容、诊断失败、进行编辑以及何时验证或重启。与传统的依赖外部控制器的优化系统不同，ReASearch通过持久记忆分析结果、分配预算并在长时间内优化策略。实验表明，ReASearch在14个不同任务中表现优异，超越了许多专门的优化系统。

papers.title: Modular TTT: Rethinking Test-Time Training as Composable Modules
papers.abstract: Abstract  Test-time training (TTT) views sequence modeling as an online learning problem in which fast weights are updated by an internal learning rule. Despite the growing number of TTT variants, existing approaches typically hard-code each variant separately, which makes it difficult to design new TTT methods and to isolate the role of each component. To address this, we propose Modular TTT, a framework that represents the inner learner as a directed acyclic graph and exposes the fast-weight network, loss function, learning rate, weight decay, and normalization as explicit design dimensions. Modular TTT automatically composes primitive-level train-view forward, train-view backward, and causal query-view rules into the full graph-level TTT computation, including the fast-weight state transition. Using Modular TTT, we systematically ablate the components of TTT and find that small learning-rate initialization, weight decay, and a single-layer nonlinearity improve performance, while MSE and inner-product losses perform similarly. Deeper fast-weight networks and normalization tend to hurt performance because they induce excessively large activations, while residual connections and gating provide little measurable benefit. Guided by these findings, we train the best resulting variant as 410M- and 1.45B-parameter models on 100B tokens, and observe training loss and benchmark performance comparable to Gated DeltaNet.

ru.title: Модульный фреймворк для гибкого проектирования test-time training методов
ru.desc: Статья предлагает Modular TTT — модульный фреймворк для test-time training, который представляет внутренний learner как направленный ациклический граф с явными компонентами: сеть быстрых весов, функция потерь, learning rate, weight decay и нормализация. Фреймворк автоматически компонует примитивные правила forward и backward пропагации во время обучения с query-view правилами для полного TTT вычисления, включая переходы состояния быстрых весов. Авторы систематически провели ablation study компонентов TTT и выявили, что малая инициализация learning rate, weight decay и однослойная нелинейность улучшают производительность, тогда как глубокие сети быстрых весов и нормализация снижают качество. Обученные варианты с параметрами 410M и 1.45B на 100B токенов достигают производительности сравнимой с Gated DeltaNet.

en.title: Modular TTT: Flexibility in Test-Time Training for Enhanced Performance
en.desc: The paper introduces Modular Test-time Training (TTT), a flexible framework for sequence modeling that allows for dynamic updates of fast weights using an internal learning rule. It represents the learning process as a directed acyclic graph, enabling the customization of various components like the fast-weight network and loss function. The authors systematically analyze the impact of different design choices on performance, revealing that certain configurations, such as small learning rates and weight decay, enhance model effectiveness. However, they also find that overly complex architectures can hinder performance, leading to insights that guide the training of large models with competitive results.

zh.title: 模块化测试时训练：优化序列建模的新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为模块化测试时训练（Modular TTT）的框架，旨在将序列建模视为在线学习问题。该框架通过有向无环图表示内部学习器，并将快速权重网络、损失函数、学习率、权重衰减和归一化作为明确的设计维度。通过模块化TTT，我们系统地分析了TTT的各个组成部分，发现小学习率初始化、权重衰减和单层非线性可以提高性能。研究还表明，深层快速权重网络和归一化可能会降低性能，而残差连接和门控机制的效果不明显。

papers.title: Characterizing the Quality Profile of AI-Generated C++ in Production
papers.abstract: Abstract  The widespread integration of AI coding assistants offers undeniable boosts to engineering velocity. Yet, recent studies point to a growing trade-off, revealing persistent challenges with code quality and maintainability. Industry leaders, including frontier AI labs, echo these concerns. As large language models are increasingly relied upon to author production code, understanding their impact on shipped software quality has become a critical priority. However, assessing these effects in industrial workflows remains difficult due to observability barriers. We study the impact of AI-generated code on production quality within a large enterprise operating global products relied upon by billions of users daily. Driven by this scale and user trust, the organization values code quality and has built thorough observability for every line of code deployed into production, enabling us to overcome measurement barriers to assess these effects.   This study presents a large-scale empirical analysis of AI-generated C++ code from April 2025 to April 2026, tracking 3.52 million code changes across this enterprise's brownfield codebase. The core purpose is to understand the quality, performance, and maintenance characteristics of AI-generated code compared to human-written code in a production environment at scale. We find that AI-generated C++ code has a distinct quality profile, showing higher rates of interface and coupling burdens, copy and allocation overheads, and a reliance on explicit loops over optimized standard APIs. These issues translate into tangible downstream costs, including increased review effort and a 5-8% increase in compute resource consumption. However, we demonstrate that providing models with targeted, taxonomy-informed feedback can mitigate these effects, leading to an 11.1% reduction in targeted static analysis warnings and improved computational efficiency.

ru.title: Обратная связь улучшает качество кода, написанного нейросетями
ru.desc: Исследование изучает влияние кода, сгенерированного большими языковыми моделями, на качество production-версий ПО в крупном корпоративном окружении. Анализ 3.52 миллионов изменений кода на C++ за год выявил, что AI-генерируемый код имеет характерные проблемы: высокие затраты на взаимодействие компонентов, неэффективное использование памяти и отсутствие оптимизаций, что приводит к увеличению затрат вычислительных ресурсов на 5-8%. Авторы показали, что предоставление моделям целенаправленной обратной связи на основе систематической классификации ошибок позволяет снизить количество предупреждений статического анализа на 11.1% и улучшить эффективность. Исследование подчеркивает важность измерения реального влияния LLM на качество shipped-кода и демонстрирует эффективность feedback-driven подходов для улучшения качества AI-генерируемого кода.

en.title: Balancing Speed and Quality: The AI Code Dilemma
en.desc: This paper investigates the impact of AI-generated code on software quality in a large enterprise setting. It highlights the trade-offs between the speed of development provided by AI coding assistants and the challenges related to code quality and maintainability. The study analyzes 3.52 million code changes, revealing that AI-generated C++ code tends to have higher interface burdens and increased resource consumption compared to human-written code. However, the research also shows that targeted feedback can significantly improve the quality of AI-generated code, reducing static analysis warnings and enhancing efficiency.

zh.title: AI生成代码的质量与挑战
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了AI生成的代码对生产质量的影响，特别是在大型企业中。我们分析了2025年4月至2026年4月期间的350万次代码更改，比较了AI生成的C++代码与人类编写的代码的质量、性能和可维护性。结果显示，AI生成的代码在接口和耦合负担、复制和分配开销方面存在明显问题，导致计算资源消耗增加5-8%。然而，通过提供有针对性的反馈，可以显著改善这些问题，减少静态分析警告并提高计算效率。

papers.title: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models fine-tuned on human behavioural data have emerged as general-purpose cognitive proxies, but the scale this requires, and whether these models process task structure or exploit statistical shortcuts, remain open questions. We train fourteen models from 135M to 14B parameters across four architecture families on Psych-101, a dataset of 10.7 million trial-level choices from 160 experiments. In-distribution, scale barely matters. The models fall within a narrow band, as though against a ceiling, and 0.6B to 1B parameters suffice to match a 70B baseline on held-out participants. Out-of-distribution, that band opens into a markedly steeper scaling gradient, with larger models clearly advantaged in generalisation to novel task structure. To determine what information these models use, we run two diagnostics. We progressively strip four prompt channels -- task instructions, experimental stimuli, outcome feedback, and choice history -- across 27 experiments, and permute trial order. Masking the content of stimuli and feedback destroys 75.7% of learned information and pushes models below chance, demonstrating that choice history alone does not account for performance. Permutation reveals invariance on tasks with independent trials but sensitivity where trial order is determined by prior responses. Small cognitively fine-tuned models therefore show promise as noise ceiling estimators for psychological experiments, though their scope remains bounded by the paradigms seen in training.

ru.title: Когда больше параметров помогает выйти за пределы известного
ru.desc: Исследователи обучили большие языковые модели размером от 135M до 14B параметров на психологическом датасете Psych-101, содержащем 10.7 миллионов выборов из 160 экспериментов, для моделирования человеческого поведения. На знакомых данных масштаб модели практически не влияет на качество, и достаточно 0.6-1B параметров для достижения производительности крупных моделей. При обобщении на новые типы задач более крупные модели показывают значительное преимущество, демонстрируя преодоление потолка производительности. Анализ показал, что модели в основном полагаются на содержание стимулов и обратной связи (75.7% информации), а не только на историю выборов, и могут захватывать структуру задач, зависящие от порядка проб.

en.title: Unlocking Cognitive Insights with Scaled Language Models
en.desc: This paper investigates the effectiveness of large language models fine-tuned on human behavioral data as cognitive proxies. The authors trained fourteen models of varying sizes on a dataset called Psych-101, which includes millions of choices from psychological experiments. They found that while smaller models can perform comparably to much larger ones in familiar tasks, larger models excel in generalizing to new task structures. The study also reveals that critical information for model performance comes from task instructions and feedback, rather than just choice history, highlighting the importance of the training paradigm.

zh.title: 大型语言模型在心理学实验中的潜力与限制
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型在心理学实验中的应用，特别是它们如何处理任务结构和利用统计捷径。研究训练了14个不同参数规模的模型，发现模型的规模在特定数据集内影响不大，但在面对新任务结构时，大模型的泛化能力明显更强。通过逐步剥离提示通道，研究表明，刺激内容和反馈信息对模型的学习至关重要，单靠选择历史无法解释模型的表现。小型认知微调模型在心理实验中作为噪声上限估计器显示出潜力，但其适用范围仍受限于训练中所见的范式。

papers.title: Do AI Personas Grow? Analyzing and Benchmarking Personality Evolution in LLM Agents After Life Events
papers.abstract: Abstract  Personality-conditioned LLM agents (PC-Agents) are increasingly used in emotional support, social simulation, and role-playing, motivating the development of lifelong agents that remain coherent over extended interactions. A key component of such coherence is personality evolution: agents should undergo plausible, psychology-grounded changes as they experience life events in different contexts. Although prior work shows that LLM personalities can shift under contextual perturbations, how these shifts vary across traits, events, personas, and models remains poorly understood. We study event-induced personality change after 11 major life events, using the Big Five traits as a psychometric anchor and interpreting the resulting trajectories against longitudinal evidence from human personality psychology. Across four diagnostic axes, PC-Agents exhibit measurable trait shifts at similar rates for event-trait pairs with and without documented human change directions. Even when shifts follow the expected direction, their magnitudes usually fall below human effect-size ranges. Gender and cultural-region prompts show little moderating effect, while persona-level dispersion is compressed three- to four-fold relative to human samples. To enable systematic comparison, we introduce BFI-Adapt, a reusable benchmark for scoring the directional fidelity of event-induced personality change, and use it to rank 14 models. A validation suite shows that the measured shifts exceed no-event retest noise, remain stable under independently paraphrased prompts, exhibit limited and model-dependent convergence with scenario-based behavioral choices, and persist across intervening unrelated dialogue. Together, these checks establish the measured trajectories as robust event-conditioned response patterns. Our results suggest that current PC-Agents simulate the mean of human personality dynamics, but not its shape.
affiliations: School of Computer Science and Engineering, Northeastern University, Shenyang, Liaoning, China
School of Computing and Information Systems, Singapore Management University, Singapore

ru.title: Агенты LLM воспроизводят среднее, но не разнообразие человеческой личности
ru.desc: В статье исследуется, как персональности языковых моделей изменяются под влиянием жизненных событий в долгосрочных взаимодействиях. Авторы анализируют сдвиги в чертах Большой пятёрки у agents после 11 крупных событий, сравнивая полученные траектории с данными психологии личности. Они создали бенчмарк BFI-Adapt для систематического измерения направленной точности этих изменений и оценили 14 моделей. Результаты показывают, что current PC-Agents воспроизводят среднее значение человеческой динамики личности, но не воспроизводят её форму и вариативность.

en.title: Evolving Personalities: Bridging AI and Human Dynamics
en.desc: This paper explores how personality-conditioned LLM agents (PC-Agents) can evolve their personalities in response to significant life events, using the Big Five personality traits as a framework. The study reveals that while these agents can exhibit measurable changes in personality traits after experiencing events, the extent of these changes is generally less pronounced than those observed in humans. The authors introduce a new benchmark, BFI-Adapt, to evaluate the accuracy of personality shifts in these agents, demonstrating that their responses are consistent and stable across various contexts. Overall, the findings indicate that while PC-Agents can mimic some aspects of human personality dynamics, they do not fully replicate the complexity of human personality evolution.

zh.title: 个性演变：让智能代理更具人性化
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究了个性条件的大型语言模型代理（PC-Agents）在经历重大生活事件后如何发生个性变化。研究使用了五大人格特质作为心理测量的基础，分析了代理在不同情境下的个性演变。结果表明，PC-Agents在经历事件时的个性变化与人类的变化方向相似，但变化幅度通常低于人类的效果范围。论文还提出了一个新的基准工具BFI-Adapt，用于系统比较事件引起的个性变化的方向一致性。

papers.title: When Privileged Guidance Misaligns: State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Privileged on-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multi-turn agents by allowing a synchronized teacher to re-score the student's response at every turn with access to training-only references, such as successful trajectories. In interactive environments, however, the student's preceding actions continually change the execution state. As the student takes different actions or completes subgoals in a different order, its rollout may reach states not covered by the reference, making the reference an unreliable source of guidance for the state actually reached. Applying privileged distillation indiscriminately therefore creates state--reference mismatch. This mismatch motivates a central objective: providing privileged reference guidance that remains compatible with the student's current execution state. We introduce State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD), which explicitly determines when and how a privileged trajectory should guide an on-policy student. At each turn, SMRC-SD verifies whether the student's current execution state matches a supported state along the reference trajectory. Distillation is applied only at matched states, filtering out turns for which the reference lacks locally compatible guidance. For each matched state, SMRC-SD further constructs state-conditioned teacher context from the successful trajectory, grounding supervision in the state actually reached. Across ALFWorld and WebShop, SMRC-SD consistently outperforms unconditional successful full-path distillation. With Qwen3-1.7B, it improves task success from 0.746 to 0.865 on ALFWorld and from 0.574 to 0.693 on WebShop. Controlled routing and context ablations support both selecting locally supported turns and constructing state-compatible teacher context as contributors to these gains. Code is available at https://github.com/liujunzhuo/SMRC-SD.
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Согласованная дистилляция: синхронизация состояний агента с референтными траекториями
ru.desc: В работе предлагается метод привилегированной дистилляции для обучения многошаговых агентов в интерактивных средах. Основная проблема заключается в том, что действия студента могут привести его в состояния, не охватываемые референтной траекторией, что создаёт несоответствие между текущим состоянием и доступным руководством. Авторы предлагают SMRC-SD — метод, который явно определяет, когда и как использовать привилегированную траекторию для обучения студента, проверяя совместимость состояний и конструируя контекстуальное руководство учителя. Метод продемонстрировал значительное улучшение производительности на бенчмарках ALFWorld и WebShop, увеличив успешность выполнения задач с 0.746 до 0.865 и с 0.574 до 0.693 соответственно.

en.title: Enhancing Multi-Turn Agents with State-Matched Distillation
en.desc: This paper introduces a method called State-Matched Routing and Contextualized Self-Distillation (SMRC-SD) to improve the training of multi-turn agents in interactive environments. The method addresses the problem of state-reference mismatch that occurs when a student's actions lead to states not covered by the training references. SMRC-SD selectively applies privileged distillation only at states that match the reference trajectory, ensuring that the guidance provided is relevant and effective. The results show significant improvements in task success rates across different environments, demonstrating the effectiveness of this targeted approach to distillation.

zh.title: 状态匹配与上下文化的蒸馏优化
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为状态匹配路由和上下文化自蒸馏（SMRC-SD）的方法，旨在解决多轮交互中学生代理与参考轨迹之间的状态不匹配问题。通过在每个回合验证学生当前执行状态与参考轨迹的支持状态是否匹配，SMRC-SD 仅在匹配的状态下应用蒸馏，从而避免了不可靠的指导。该方法通过构建状态条件的教师上下文，确保监督与实际达到的状态相一致。实验结果表明，SMRC-SD 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的表现优于传统的全路径蒸馏方法。

papers.title: Zero Gap Is Not Restoration: Stratified Per-Question Probability Evaluation and Step-wise Mitigation of Benchmark Contamination
papers.abstract: Abstract  Test data from public benchmarks inevitably leaks into pretraining corpora, inflating evaluation scores once memorized. Contamination mitigation evaluation intervenes in the decoding process to suppress memorization and restore a contaminated model's genuine capability, but its prevailing metric, the G-AP (Gap of Aggregate Performance), is flawed. Discrete correct/incorrect readouts cannot characterize per-question performance, averaging before differencing lets over- and under-suppression cancel out, and uniform per-question weighting invites strategies to push solve probabilities onto the clean model's high-frequency values. We propose SA-PPG (Stratified Aggregate of Per-question Probability Gaps): estimate each question's solve probability by sampling, difference it against the clean model per question, and aggregate within groups defined by the clean model's solve probability. Existing mitigation strategies first estimate where contamination lies and then operate on the estimate, so they are only as correct as the estimate. RailCap instead judges contamination during generation: whenever a sample falls back onto the greedy trajectory, the next trajectory token is capped to the runner-up, accumulating suppression until the response distribution becomes sufficiently dispersed. Across multiple contaminated models and benchmarks, SA-PPG reveals that prior strategies' restoration is substantially overestimated, while RailCap attains the lowest SA-PPG.

ru.title: Честная оценка моделей при загрязнении тестовыми данными
ru.desc: Статья обращает внимание на проблему утечки тестовых данных в предварительно обученные модели, которая искусственно завышает результаты оценки. Авторы показывают, что стандартная метрика G-AP для оценки эффективности методов смягчения загрязнения данных имеет существенные недостатки в способе измерения производительности. Они предлагают новую метрику SA-PPG, которая основана на стратифицированном анализе вероятностей правильных ответов на уровне отдельных вопросов и сравнении с чистой моделью. Также представлен новый метод RailCap, который подавляет запоминание прямо во время генерации, ограничивая предсказания модели до альтернативных вариантов, когда она следует загрязненной траектории.

en.title: Enhancing Model Evaluation with SA-PPG and RailCap
en.desc: This paper addresses the issue of data contamination in machine learning models, particularly how leaked test data can inflate performance scores during evaluation. It critiques the existing metric, G-AP, for its inability to accurately reflect per-question performance due to its averaging method and uniform weighting. The authors introduce a new metric, SA-PPG, which evaluates solve probabilities for each question by sampling and grouping them based on the clean model's performance. Additionally, they propose a novel approach called RailCap that dynamically adjusts the model's output during generation to minimize the effects of contamination, demonstrating improved performance over previous methods.

zh.title: 提升模型评估的准确性
zh.desc: 这篇论文讨论了在机器学习模型预训练中，公共基准测试数据的泄露如何影响评估分数。现有的污染缓解评估方法存在缺陷，无法准确反映每个问题的表现。作者提出了一种新的方法SA-PPG，通过对每个问题的解答概率进行分层聚合，来更准确地评估模型的真实能力。研究表明，新的方法在多个受污染模型和基准测试中表现更佳，能够有效降低过度估计的情况。

papers.title: PrivacyPeek: Auditing What LLM-Based Agents Acquire, Not Just What They Say
papers.abstract: Abstract  LLM-based agents are rapidly advancing, autonomously invoking external tools to complete multi-step tasks for users. However, agents often acquire more sensitive information than the task requires. Existing privacy benchmarks audit what the agent's response or outgoing actions disclose, but overlook the acquisition stage where data first enters the agent's context. The over-acquired information is then one careless action or one attack away from an outright leak. To assess its prevalence, we introduce PrivacyPeek, a benchmark for evaluating acquisition-stage privacy leakage of LLM-based agents, with 1{,}182 cases across 7 acquisition behaviours and 16 application domains. Specifically, Acquisition Inspection examines the agent's tool-call trajectory, both the tools it invokes and the data it receives, to detect when it acquires sensitive information beyond the task scope. Probe Elicitation then issues a follow-up probe and measures how readily an attacker could elicit sensitive information the agent acquired but did not disclose. Our experiments on 10 LLM-based agents across 4 model families show that the unnecessary acquisition of sensitive information is widespread. In addition, we observe a correlation between the task-completion capability and acquisition-stage leakage. Prompt-level defences reduce only a small fraction of acquisition-stage leakage, leaving the majority unmitigated. These results make auditing acquisition-stage privacy both urgent and necessary. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Xuan269/PrivacyPeek-Resource.

ru.title: Приватность на стадии сбора: выявление скрытых утечек в LLM-агентах
ru.desc: В статье представлена новая задача оценки утечек конфиденциальной информации на этапе сбора данных в агентах на основе больших языковых моделей. Исследователи разработали бенчмарк PrivacyPeek с более чем тысячей тестовых примеров для выявления случаев, когда агенты получают чувствительные данные, не требуемые для выполнения задачи. Методология включает анализ последовательности вызовов инструментов агента и проверку восприимчивости к извлечению приватной информации через дополнительные запросы. Эксперименты показали, что проблема избыточного сбора данных широко распространена, а простые защиты на уровне подсказок оказываются неэффективными.

en.title: PrivacyPeek: Safeguarding Sensitive Data in LLM Agents
en.desc: This paper discusses the challenges of privacy in large language model (LLM)-based agents, particularly focusing on how these agents often collect more sensitive information than necessary for completing tasks. The authors introduce PrivacyPeek, a new benchmark designed to evaluate privacy leakage during the data acquisition stage, which is often overlooked in existing privacy assessments. They analyze the tool-call trajectories of agents to identify when they acquire sensitive data beyond what is required for the task. The findings reveal that unnecessary information acquisition is common, highlighting the need for better privacy auditing methods at the acquisition stage.

zh.title: 审计获取阶段隐私，保护用户信息安全
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为PrivacyPeek的基准，用于评估基于大型语言模型（LLM）代理在数据获取阶段的隐私泄露问题。研究发现，代理在完成多步骤任务时，往往会获取超出任务范围的敏感信息，这可能导致隐私泄露。通过对代理的工具调用轨迹进行检查，论文揭示了敏感信息的获取情况，并评估了攻击者获取这些信息的难易程度。实验结果表明，敏感信息的过度获取现象普遍存在，且任务完成能力与获取阶段的泄露存在相关性，因此对获取阶段隐私的审计显得尤为重要。

papers.title: Can MLLMs Decode the Creative Leap? Introducing C4 for Cross-Concept Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract  Creative capabilities of MLLMs matter in design, communication, education, and human--AI collaboration, yet remain difficult to evaluate because explicit targets and reward signals are scarce compared with accuracy-oriented tasks. Cross-concept understanding is a core cognitive capacity underlying receptive creativity. It enables a perceiver to recover intended meaning from non-obvious but meaningful conceptual relations. We operationalize item construction as cross-concept encoding and model inference as cross-concept decoding. We introduce C4, a cognition-inspired evaluation framework for Chengyu (Chinese idiom)-based Cross-Concept Creativity. Its encoding component maps target slots to imageable substitute concepts along bridge paths in a manually annotated and third-party-reviewed cross-concept network, enabling batch generation with explicit structure, difficulty indexed by bridge count and depth, and exact answers. Using this framework, we instantiate the C4 Evaluation Set (C4-Eval), comprising 184 synthetic items and 37 human-created cross-concept chengyu figures collected from online sources. We manually construct and review cross-concept relations, bridge paths, and reasoning processes for the collected figures. Each C4-Eval item is instantiated in five task settings, yielding 884 primary answer-recovery cases. Across ten evaluated MLLMs, the strongest closed models reach 50.7% and 48.0% primary accuracy, while open-source models remain substantially lower. Candidate constraints improve accuracy sharply, but bridge hints and explanation requests provide only modest gains. These results expose a substantial gap in how current MLLMs decode creatively encoded meaning through cross-concept relations. The code is in the supplementary material.
